summary.de: Der Felsunterstand liegt am Mau-Steilhang westlich des Naivashasees. Mehrere seiner Straußeneierschalenperlen gingen in den regionalen Vergleich ein.
summary.en: The rockshelter stands on the Mau Escarpment west of Lake Naivasha. Several of its ostrich eggshell beads were included in the regional comparison.
